footer.about: Pioneer Roofing is a metal roofing company at 202 SW Center St in Peoria, IL. It installs residential and commercial metal roofs and handles repairs, for Peoria and nearby towns.

why: Your site has real metal roofing pages for homes, commercial buildings, standing seam, corrugated and installation and design. Their headlines say METAL ROOFS and STANDING SEAM METAL ROOFS with no city, so someone searching for a metal roof in Peoria has nothing built for that phrase.

At least 36 town pages each say "Pioneer Roofing Experts in" a town, and they are one page with the town name swapped, so Google reads the same words again and again. The Phone button on every one we checked dials (321) 399-2147, not the (309) 865-5471 printed everywhere else.
So we built a site around the work your site leads with: metal roofing in Peoria on a page of its own, the towns you serve on the homepage, and one phone number.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the Roofer People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one page: what your site does today and what we changed.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: The page Google reads to learn who you are and where you work.
problems: Your headline says Roofing Contractor Peoria, IL but never says metal, so a homeowner looking for a metal roof can't tell it is what you do best.
The Services item in your menu goes nowhere when clicked; it only opens a list, so there is no page that explains what you do.
fixes: A headline that says roofer in Peoria, IL, with metal roofing in the first lines under it.
Your services and your towns told on the homepage itself.
cards.alsoAdd: Every page set up behind the scenes so Google and AI tools like ChatGPT know exactly what you do, where you work, and what your customers say.

cards.title: Metal Roofing
cards.why: Metal roofing is your specialty, and today it is spread over six short pages.
problems: Each metal page runs about 260 to 300 words, and none of the headlines names Peoria, so a search for metal roofing in Peoria, IL doesn't match them.
A homeowner has to open six pages to see which kinds of metal roof you install.
fixes: One page for metal roofing in Peoria, IL, covering homes, commercial buildings and the kinds of metal roof you install.
A call to action on the page, with one phone number.
cards.alsoAdd: Pages planned from what Google actually shows for each search, so every page targets something people really look for.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: Where someone with a roof question decides to call.
problems: The Phone button on your town pages dials (321) 399-2147, an area code that isn't Peoria's, so a caller from one of those pages reaches a different line.
Your contact page is 79 words: a headline and a form, with no address written on it.
fixes: A contact page with your address and the one number that matches your Google listing.
A short list of what to say when you call.
cards.alsoAdd: Call and form tracking that shows which pages and towns your leads come from.

closing.heading: Want a website like this for your business?
closing.text: One customer calls you responsive, and another calls you fair and transparent. Book a strategy call with Fluid Frame and we'll walk you through this demo and plan your new site.

confirm.heading: What we'd confirm with you
confirm.intro: Google and AI tools see different answers about your business in different places. We wrote this demo from your reviews and your site. On a short onboarding call, we'd confirm these so everything says the same thing.
items: Your site and your Google listing show (309) 865-5471, while the Phone button on your town pages dials (321) 399-2147, so which number is live, and why is there a second one? This demo uses the Google number.
Your town pages say "experienced and certified professionals" without naming a certification, so which manufacturer or program certifications can we name, and where do we show proof?
Search results for "Pioneer Roofing" turn up other companies of that name, including a commercial listing on GAF and profiles on BBB in other states, so which listings are yours?

offer.heading: The offer we'd build with you
offer.text: This is a proposal for you to decide on, not something Pioneer Roofing does today. It is a one-page metal roof spec handed to the owner before the work starts: the kind of panel and finish, how it is fastened, what goes underneath, how the edges, valleys and vents are handled, and what you and the manufacturer each stand behind. As far as we found, none of the three competitor sites we could read offers a sheet like it.
points: The sheet is filled in for the owner's actual roof, one line for each of those details.
A homeowner can set that sheet beside any other bid, shingle or metal.
Terms and what you put in writing are yours to set.
